title: Versioned Transitive Dependency-Closure Binding and Operation-Time Effect Governance for Agent Skills: ClosureBound
abstract: arXiv:2609.05920v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agent Skills combine instructions with files, packages, tools, models, and services, so operational identity can exceed a signed directory. Recursive or lazy dependencies may change while root-level evidence remains valid, and different surfaces may reach the same durable effect. We present ClosureBound, a reference monitor that prevents authorization transfer across material changes to this heterogeneous closure. Its resolver commits typed graph nodes and topology. Each grant binds an exact closure root, effect ceiling, purpose/provenance, validity, and epochs. At durability, it re-resolves closure and state, normalizes the operation into an external-effect IR, and admits it only if a joint witness satisfies every bound. Supported equivalent paths share one ceiling. translated_title: 面向智能体技能的版本化传递依赖闭包绑定与运行时效果治理：ClosureBound
translated_abstract: 智能体技能将指令与文件、软件包、工具、模型和服务相结合，因此运行时身份可能超出签名目录所覆盖的范围。递归或惰性依赖可能在根级证据仍然有效的情况下发生变化，并且不同的调用路径可能达到相同的持久效果。我们提出了ClosureBound，这是一种引用监控器，可防止授权在此异构闭包发生实质性变化时发生转移。其解析器提交带类型的图节点和拓扑结构。每个授权绑定一个精确的闭包根、效果上限、目的/来源、有效期和时期。在持久化时，系统重新解析闭包和状态，将操作规范化为外部效果中间表示（IR），只有当联合见证满足所有绑定时才允许该操作。受支持的等价路径共享同一个上限。在假设完全中介与发现、经过认证的新鲜性、可靠的规范化、密码学绑定和权威线性化的前提下，我们建立了元数据非……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: ClosureBound通过版本化绑定异构依赖闭包、设置效果上限以及运行时联合见证验证，防止授权在依赖发生实质性变化时被非法转移。
en_tdlr: ClosureBound prevents authorization transfer across material changes to agent skills' heterogeneous dependency closures via versioned closure binding, effect ceilings, and operation-time joint witness verification.
